apps.description: Independent AirSIM client for Cardputer Zero. Connect to an Android phone running AirSIM using Wi-Fi discovery/manual pairing or VoBLE Bluetooth, or to a compatible MU-300 running the AirSIM MU-300 plugin over Wi-Fi. Make and answer calls, send and receive SMS, use two-way call audio, and view device battery, unread messages and missed-call numbers. Includes local contacts, call records, SIM selection and DTMF. For reliable Wi-Fi reception, avoid simultaneous local SMS synchronization by other clients. Store screenshots and the older UI recording use synthetic data; the separately attached physical-device video was supplied and approved for publication by the user. An Android phone with AirSIM and its required permissions is needed. This is not an official AirSIM release.

apps.title: amiibo_sim
apps.summary: Amiibo模拟器
apps.description:
1、项目介绍
使用Cap CC1101内置的 ST25R3916 NFC 芯片，模拟Amiibo，支持刷新随机UID
.bin文件需由用户自行添加至~/amiibo_sim

2、准备工作

- 关机装好 Cap CC1101，开机后在 `Settings → ExtPort` 中确认 EXT D+/D− 处于 GPIO 模式。
- 从 APPLaunch 打开 `amiibo_sim`。如果屏幕显示 `NFC SPI missing` 或 `SPI access denied`，需运行：
sudo /usr/lib/amiibo_sim/cap-setup

应用只检测 SPI 状态。上面的命令由用户授权执行，负责加载 NFC SPI 配置并设置设备访问权限。应用会自动复查，也可以按 H 立即检查。看到 CAP ST25R3916 connected 即可选卡。临时加载的 SPI 配置在重启后需要重新启用。
- 应用会尝试自动开启 EXT 5V。如果显示 EXT 5V failed，需在 Settings → ExtPort 手动开启 EXT 5V，再按 H。

3、导入文件和操作
首次打开会自动创建 ~/amiibo_sim/。把自己的 540 字节 Amiibo .bin 备份放进这个目录，再按 T 刷新列表。支持中文文件名。
- F / X 或方向键选文件，Enter 开始模拟。
- 若要随机刷新 UID，把与备份匹配的 160 字节密钥放在同一目录。文件名可用 key_retail.bin 或 retail.bin，屏幕右上角会显示密钥状态。
- 模拟时移开手柄，按 R 换 UID，按 O 恢复原始 UID。
- Esc 停止模拟，再按一次退出。
安装包不包含 Amiibo 备份或密钥，需自行导入。

4、更新
- 0.18 存在bug，不可使用
- 0.19 已支持在 ~/amiibo_sim/ 中添加文件夹

交流QQ群号：423629503

apps.title: Remote
apps.summary: 让 CardputerZero 变成一台「开着就能远程操作」的小电脑：局域网里任何手机/电脑打开浏览器，就能实时看到它的屏幕、用键盘操控它
apps.description:
## 它解决什么问题
CardputerZero 屏幕小、键盘迷你，调试和演示都不方便。装上这个应用后，只要设备开着机，你在局域网里用手机扫个码（或电脑输个网址）就能：

- 实时看屏幕 ：设备画面以 MJPEG 推流到浏览器（12fps、2 倍放大），页面以机身线稿为底图，屏幕内容和按键高亮直接叠在「机身」上，像看真机一样。
- 远程敲键盘 ：守护进程创建 uinput 虚拟键盘并接管系统键盘设备，浏览器里敲的字（电脑物理键盘 / 手机软键盘）直接注入设备；真实机身键盘的事件同时转发，两边都能用、互不打断。
- 带外壳录屏 ：网页端一键录制，可选「带外壳」模式把按键动效一起录进去，存到设备`/tmp/cardputer-rec/` 后随时下载；设备端 ffmpeg 方案保留作后备。
## 设备端应用（启动器里的入口）
启动器里的 Remote 应用是「入口 + 配置面板」：

- 中英双语界面，显示设备 IP、端口、服务运行状态，并生成二维码，手机扫码即连。
- IP 由`hostname -I` 动态获取，不是写死的。
- 改端口 ：按数字键输入 1024–65535 之间的端口号，按 ENTER 保存——守护进程在进程内原地重绑端口，不重启服务、不杀当前应用。
- 启动做了优化：先把上一帧缓存刷到屏幕（约 0.1s 出画面），再懒加载绘图库渲染完整界面。

apps.title: Cardputer TV
apps.summary: Cardputer Zero 轻量视频播放器，支持自定义源及帧率设置；订阅兼容性仅做有限样本测试。
apps.description:
Cardputer TV 是面向 M5Stack Cardputer Zero 的轻量视频播放器，适配设备自带 320×170 屏幕、键盘和扬声器。

【功能】
• 自定义播放源：支持 M3U/M3U8 频道列表、频道 JSON、兼容的 HTTP(S)/HLS 媒体地址，以及部分 TVBox 配置中的直播列表。
• 单路播放：切换频道时先结束旧播放，再加载新频道；等待时保留最后一帧并显示“正在加载”，不进行双路预加载。
• 音量控制：播放中每次增减 5%，屏幕显示实际音量百分比。
• 帧率设置：20 / 30 / 60 帧可选，默认 20 帧；保存后下次开始播放生效，重启应用后保留。

【订阅源兼容性说明｜测试范围有限】
订阅源尚未经过充分测试。目前仅做了有限样本验证，真机实播以少量直播频道为主，尚未对各家订阅服务、不同格式变体和 TVBox 配置开展广泛兼容性测试。不能保证所有订阅源都能解析、列出频道或正常播放；部分源可能需要特定请求头、访问条件或不受支持的解析方式。请以自己的实际测试结果为准。

【从电脑导入源文件】
可先在电脑上编辑 UTF-8 的 sources.json，再通过 SFTP 或 ADB 传到运行应用用户的 ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json，重新打开应用读取。请先退出应用并备份原配置；覆盖文件会替换整个源列表，不会自动合并。~ 指应用用户的主目录，实际用户名以设备为准，配置文件建议权限 600。
也可以上传 M3U 频道列表或频道 JSON，在 Tab 源管理中按 N 新增，将 URL 填为设备上的绝对路径，保存后选中该源并回车切换。文件内容修改后按 R 刷新。含私人 Token 的配置仅保存在自己的设备，请勿公开。

【按键】
频道列表：F/X 或上下选择频道，长按可加速连续选台，Z/C 或左右翻页，回车播放，Tab 管理源，S 打开播放设置。
播放中：F/X 切换频道，Z/C 调整音量，Esc 停止并返回列表。
播放设置：F/X 或方向键选择帧率，回车保存，Esc 取消。

【片源与隐私】
本应用不附带私人订阅、付费账号或商业频道聚合源，仅提供 Big Buck Bunny 公开测试流。请自行添加有权访问和播放的源。第三方源的内容、可用性和访问条件由其提供者决定；播放时会连接所选源及媒体服务器并消耗网络流量。源配置和帧率偏好保存在设备当前用户目录，升级不会覆盖已有源配置。
不支持 DRM 加密节目、加密订阅解密或需要 jar/spider 执行的点播接口。

【运行要求与性能】
适用于 Cardputer Zero 的原生 Linux/APPLaunch 环境，使用内置屏幕和音频输出，需要读取设备键盘和写入 framebuffer 的权限。依赖 Python 3、Pillow、python3-evdev、FFmpeg 和 pulseaudio-utils，由软件包声明；网络播放需要联网。无需相机、麦克风、额外硬件或应用专属后台服务。
当前使用软件解码。设置帧率是视频输出目标，不保证每个源都达到该帧率，也不代表 LCD 的物理刷新率；高分辨率、高复杂度编码或网络波动会影响连续性。高于片源原始帧率时包含重复帧。

apps.title: CardRouter
apps.summary: 把CardputerZero 变成一台口袋卡片路由器：开热点、共享上网、管理设备。
apps.description:
Card Router 把你的 CardputerZero 变成一台小巧的卡片路由器。插上网线，或无线中继家里的 Wi-Fi，它就能开出热点，让手机、电脑共享上网，并提供一套完整的路由管理功能。
主要功能：
· 开机引导向导：首次使用一步步配好语言、上网方式、热点名称密码、局域网网段，几分钟即可上手。
· 状态首页：实时显示运行状态、上联地址、路由地址、上下行速率曲线和在线客户端数。
· 客户端管理：查看已连接设备，给它起备注名，一键拉黑，按需查看信号强度。
· 路由设置：名称、密码、网段、DHCP 范围、上行方式，点哪项直接改哪项，无需重走向导。
· 端口转发：把外部端口映射到内网设备（TCP/UDP）。
· DNS 覆盖：自定义域名解析，把域名指向指定 IP（如内网 NAS），或屏蔽广告域名。
· 设备黑名单：从已连接设备里直接选择拉黑，不用手输 MAC。
· 静态租约：给指定设备固定 IP，同样从已连接设备选择。
· QoS 限速：选择档位限制带宽（关闭/2/5/10/20/50 Mbps）。
· WireGuard：放入配置即可一键连接 VPN。
· 无线中继：单射频以 wlan1 连接上级 Wi-Fi、热点跟随同信道；也支持有线上行。
· 开放热点：密码留空即为无密码开放网络。
· 中英文界面随时切换。
快捷键：
· 首页：F/X 上下移动，M 总菜单，T 启动/停止（需输入设备密码确认），S 路由设置，C 客户端，A 高级功能，W 配置向导，ESC 退出。
· 客户端页：R 改名，B 拉黑，S 查看信号。
· 规则页（转发/DNS/黑名单/租约）：Enter 添加，DEL 删除。
· 向导/编辑：Enter 下一步或保存，ESC 返回。
· Ctrl+L：切换中英文。
说明：无线中继与热点共用一块射频，速率约为单独使用的一半，热点信道会跟随上级路由。路由由系统服务托管，退出应用后仍继续运行；按 T 停止后设备自身仍可联网。

Card Router turns your CardputerZero into a compact card-sized router. Plug in Ethernet, or wirelessly relay your home Wi-Fi, and it opens a hotspot so phones and computers can share the connection — with a full set of router management tools.
Features:
· First-boot wizard: step-by-step setup of language, uplink, hotspot name/password, and LAN subnet.
· Live dashboard: running state, uplink/router addresses, real-time up/down rate chart, and online client count.
· Client management: see connected devices, add note names, block with one tap, view signal on demand.
· Router settings: edit name, password, subnet, DHCP range, or uplink directly — jump straight to the item you want.
· Port forwarding: map external ports to LAN devices (TCP/UDP).
· DNS overrides: custom domain-to-IP mapping (e.g. a LAN NAS) or ad-domain blocking.
· Device blocklist: pick a connected device to block — no manual MAC entry.
· Static leases: assign a fixed IP to a chosen device.
· QoS limit: pick a bandwidth tier (Off/2/5/10/20/50 Mbps).
· WireGuard: drop in a config and connect with one tap.
· Wireless repeater: a single radio joins the upstream Wi-Fi via wlan1 with the hotspot on the same channel; wired uplink also supported.
· Open hotspot: leave the password blank for an open network.
· Chinese/English UI switching.
Shortcuts:
· Home: F/X move, M menu, T start/stop (device password required), S router settings, C clients, A advanced, W wizard, ESC exit.
· Clients: R rename, B block, S signal.
· Rule pages: Enter add, DEL delete.
· Wizard/edit: Enter next/save, ESC back.
· Ctrl+L: toggle language.
Note: wireless repeater and hotspot share one radio (about half throughput); the hotspot follows the upstream channel. Routing is hosted by system services and keeps running after you exit the app; after T-stop the device itself stays online.

apps.title: Battery Saver
apps.summary: Longer battery life: USB autosuspend, screen-off idle, low-battery shutdown
apps.description:
Battery Saver cuts the CardputerZero's battery drain by about a quarter with the screen on and about 40% with it off, so the 1750 mAh cell lasts roughly 5.6 h instead of 4.2 h on screen, and 7.5 h instead of 4.4 h off screen.

**Always on**
- Lets the internal USB Ethernet chip autosuspend. The kernel keeps it awake, which keeps the whole USB bus busy at ~8000 interrupts/s (~105 mA). USB devices and Ethernet cables still work when plugged in.
- Optional: silence the launcher's key sounds so the sound card can sleep (~35 mA).

**While the screen is off**
- Parks the launcher's audio stream so the sound card sleeps (~40 mA).
- Pauses the launcher, which keeps redrawing the LCD with the backlight off (~30 mA).
- Any key wakes everything up instantly.

**Low battery**
- Shuts down cleanly at 8% (5–20% or never).

WiFi, SSH and Tailscale keep working. Each measure can be switched off in the app, which also shows the live battery current. The service runs as the desktop user, not root.

Keys: F/X move, Z/C or Enter change, I info, Esc back.

apps.summary: Peers for Tailscale (unofficial): QR login, device list, one-key SSH, copy IPs
apps.description:
Peers is an unofficial Tailscale companion for the CardputerZero, like the device list of the desktop app.

**Log in with your phone**
- Not logged in yet? Press Enter: a QR code appears on the screen. Scan it with your phone and log in there; the Cardputer joins your tailnet by itself. The link is shown too, to open on any other device.
- Log out from the This Cardputer page (m, then o).
- Tailscale not installed? Press Enter to install it with the official script (needs sudo and internet).

**Devices**
- Every device on your tailnet: online first, with its Tailscale IP and how you reach it (direct, DERP relay, or when it was last seen). The exit node in use is marked EXIT.
- Type / to filter by name, IP or OS.

**Per device** (Enter)
- SSH: asks for the user and port once per device, then runs ssh right in the launcher's built-in terminal; when the session ends you are back in the list.
- Copy the IPv4, IPv6 or DNS name. There is no system clipboard, so the copy is kept for the cz-peers-clip command: ssh pi@$(cz-peers-clip) in the CLI app.
- Shell here: bash with $IP and $HOST set to that device.
- tailscale ping (shows direct or DERP and the latency), details (owner, OS, traffic, key expiry, tags), use as exit node.

**SSH keys**
- K makes an SSH key if there is none and shows the public key as a QR code to scan with your phone.
- k on a device logs in once with its password and adds the key to its authorized_keys (Linux, macOS and Windows), so ssh needs no password after that.
- When ssh is refused, the app explains why and offers the next step: add the key, show it, or forget a changed host key. Devices that run Tailscale SSH are marked with a blue S.

**This Cardputer** (m)
- IPs, MagicDNS name, account, key expiry (warns 14 days ahead), health warnings.
- Connect / disconnect (t), choose an exit node and LAN access (e), log out (o).

Runs inside the launcher's terminal and talks to tailscaled directly; nothing runs in the background. Installing lets the desktop user change Tailscale settings (tailscale set --operator); if Tailscale is installed later, the app offers to do that when a change is refused.

apps.title: flightZero
apps.summary: 专为 CardputerZero 打造的轻量级实时航空雷达与全球空域监视应用，支持本地雷达、全球全景下钻、航司识别与中英双语切换。
apps.description:
**FlightZero** 是一款运行于 CardputerZero（`arm64` / `320×170` 屏幕）的实时 ADS-B 航班监视工具，集成本地机场雷达、全球空域全景与航班详情查询，全键盘即可流畅操作。

#### 核心功能
- **本地雷达视图（Local Radar）**
  - 以选定机场或实时 GNSS / 北斗定位（`GPS`）为中心扫描周边空域，实时绘制航班航向机徽、运动尾迹、邻近机场及水系/海岸线底图。
  - 底部状态栏实时显示选中航班的呼号、机型、高度、地速、距离与升降趋势。
- **全球空域全景（Global Map）**
  - 一屏俯瞰全球实时航班分布（`x1`），支持保形多级缩放（如 `x4` 聚焦东亚及中国空域）与山脉/盆地/海域地形标注。
  - 移动光标并按 `Enter` 可直接下钻至对应位置的局部雷达视图。
- **航班列表与航司识别**
  - 列表视图按距离由近及远排序，方便快速定位最近航班。
  - 按 `Enter` 打开详情弹窗，自动识别常见 ICAO 呼号前缀并显示航司名称，同时展示机型、注册号、应答机编码、高度、地速、升降率、航向、距离、方位及经纬度。
- **81 座机场数据库与坐标参考**
  - 内置覆盖国内省会枢纽及全球主要机场的 81 座机场基准点，按 `C` 键支持输入首字母/简码实时筛选，并支持切换至实时 GNSS 卫星定位。
  - 按 `K` 键查看当前机场雷达详情，同步提供 **WGS84** 航空坐标与 **火星坐标系 GCJ-02（高德参考）**，以及标高、主跑道方向和邻近机场距离。
- **双语界面与灵活设置**
  - 支持简体中文 / English 一键即时切换（`L` 键），支持公制（`km / m`）与航空单位切换（`U` 键）。
  - 系统设置中可自定义局部雷达半径、局部刷新周期、全球缓存周期与网络接口加速模式，修改后自动保存。

#### 常用快捷键
- `Tab` / `1-3`：切换本地雷达 / 全球地图 / 航班列表
- `方向键` / `W A S D`：平移地图 / 移动光标或列表行
- `I` / `O`（或 `+` / `-`）：缩放雷达半径或全球地图倍率
- `N` / `P`（或 `.` / `,`）：切换上 / 下一架飞机
- `Enter`：查看航班详情 / 全球视图下钻
- `C` / `K`：切换基准机场或定位 / 查看机场坐标与跑道详情
- `F` / `G`：回到机场中心 / 切换 GNSS 定位
- `U` / `L` / `R`：切换单位 / 切换中英文 / 立即强制刷新
- `M` / `H`（`?`）：打开系统设置 / 查看按键说明

**Short Description:**
Real-time local flight radar and global ADS-B airspace tracker for CardputerZero, featuring 81 airport beacons, airline lookup, GNSS support, and instant EN/CN switching.

**Features:**
- **Local Radar & Global Map:** Track nearby aircraft with heading sprites, trails, and coastlines, or zoom (`x1`–`x4`) across the global airspace and press `Enter` to drill down.
- **Flight List & Detail:** Distance-sorted traffic list and detailed aircraft card with ICAO airline prefix lookup, squawk, altitude, groundspeed, vertical rate, bearing, and coordinates.
- **81 Airports & Dual Coordinates:** Fast prefix search (`C`) plus instant GNSS mode, and airport info modal (`K`) showing both WGS84 and GCJ-02 reference coordinates, elevation, and primary runway headings.
- **Full Keyboard Control & Bilingual UI:** Instant English/Chinese toggle (`L`), Metric/Aviation unit switch (`U`), and configurable refresh intervals (`M`).

apps.title: Jiggler
apps.summary: Keeps a connected computer awake by simulating mouse or keyboard activity over U
apps.description:
Jiggler turns your CardputerZero into a tiny USB mouse/keyboard that keeps a connected computer from going idle, sleeping or locking. No software or drivers are needed on the computer. It works with Windows and macOS.                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 How to use                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  1. Set the USB switch to Device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  2. Plug the right-side USB-C port into the computer (it charges the Cardputer at the same time).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  3. Open Jiggler and press 4 to start.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

Controls (the five keys under the screen)
  4  Start / stop
  5  Mode: Mouse → Keyboard → Mouse + Keyboard
  6 / 7  Shorter / longer interval
  8  Info
  ESC (hold)  Exit

Details
  - Mouse mode nudges the pointer a few pixels and moves it straight back, so it never drifts away.
  - Keyboard mode only taps Shift, so nothing is ever typed.
  - Moves happen at random times inside a window you set (default 5–15 s) instead of a fixed beat.
  - While jiggling, the screen turns off after 30 s to save battery and heat. Any key wakes it without triggering an action.
  - Your mode and interval are remembered between sessions.
  - Light and dark themes.

Installs a small boot-time service (jiggler-hid-gadget) that sets up the USB keyboard/mouse. It runs without root and does nothing else.

apps.title: LoFiBox
apps.summary: Music player with library, metadata scraping, lyrics, EQ and network sources
apps.description:
LoFiBox is a music player built for Cardputer Zero, bringing a local music library, online metadata scraping, network sources and several control interfaces to a handheld device.

- Library browsing and search: add multiple local music folders, index your collection, browse by artist, album, song, genre, composer or compilation, and search and sort the library.
- Music metadata scraping: read embedded tags, match and fill in song information, album covers and lyrics online, and cache matching results locally. When the format, write permissions and writeback rules allow it, metadata, artwork or lyrics can be written back to local music files.
- Playback and queue: pause, resume, skip, seek, adjust volume, shuffle, repeat one or repeat all. Use the playback queue and built-in smart playlists for recently added, most played and recently played music.
- Covers and lyrics: see album artwork and track information in Now Playing. The lyrics page supports plain lyrics and synchronized highlighting, using embedded content or online matches.
- Equalizer and presets: adjust frequency gains with a 10-band equalizer and switch presets.
- Network sources: configure media servers such as Jellyfin, Emby and OpenSubsonic/Navidrome, or play network audio URLs and internet radio. Supply a reachable service address and any required account permissions.
- Device controls and visualization: contextual icon actions map to keys 4-8. Now Playing uses a translucent background spectrum, and the three white keyboard LEDs follow its rightmost column.
- Stop-and-exit and screen timers: the close timer stops playback and exits LoFiBox without powering off the device. An independent idle-screen timer turns off the backlight while music continues; the first wake key only wakes the display. Both timers reset to OFF when the app is reopened.
- Multiple control interfaces: the device GUI, terminal TUI, command-line CLI and browser WebUI share playback state. Control the player remotely from a browser on the local network.

Online scraping results depend on the network and available data sources. This release provides built-in smart playlists and does not include custom playlist editing.

zh-CN.title: LoFiBox
zh-CN.summary: 集音乐库、信息刮削、歌词、均衡器和网络音源于一体的掌上音乐播放器。
zh-CN.description:
LoFiBox 是一款为 Cardputer Zero 打造的音乐播放器，将本地音乐库、联网刮削、网络音源和多种控制界面集中在掌上设备中。

- 音乐库浏览与搜索：添加多个本地音乐目录，建立音乐索引，按歌手、专辑、歌曲、流派、作曲者和合辑浏览，支持搜索与排序。
- 音乐信息刮削：读取音乐文件中的标签，联网匹配并补全歌曲信息、专辑封面和歌词，在本地缓存匹配结果。在文件格式与写入权限支持、结果符合写入规则时，可将元数据、封面或歌词回写到本地音乐文件。
- 播放与队列：支持暂停、继续、上一首、下一首、进度跳转、音量调整、随机播放、单曲循环和列表循环；提供播放队列，以及最近添加、最多播放、最近播放等内置智能歌单。
- 封面与歌词：播放页显示专辑封面和曲目信息，歌词页支持普通歌词与随播放进度高亮的同步歌词，可使用文件内嵌内容或在线匹配结果。
- 均衡器与预设：提供 10 段均衡器和预设切换，可按喜好调整各频段增益。
- 网络音源：可配置 Jellyfin、Emby、OpenSubsonic/Navidrome 等媒体服务器，也可播放网络音频地址与网络电台；需自行提供可访问的服务地址及必要的账号权限。
- 设备交互与音乐可视化：各页面提供与数字键 4–8 对应的图标操作；Now Playing 使用半透明背景频谱，三颗白色键盘灯跟随最右侧频谱柱变化。
- 定时关闭与息屏：定时关闭会停止播放并退出 LoFiBox，不关闭设备电源；独立的定时息屏在音乐继续播放时关闭背光，首次唤醒按键只负责唤醒。两个计时设置在重新打开应用后均恢复为关闭。
- 多种控制方式：设备图形界面、终端界面 TUI、命令行 CLI 和浏览器 WebUI 共用播放状态，可通过局域网浏览器遥控播放器。

在线刮削的可用结果取决于网络和数据源。本版提供内置智能歌单，不包含自定义歌单编辑功能。

• 扫描音乐目录：默认扫描 ~/Music，支持 MP3、FLAC、M4A/MP4；列出曲目并标记是否已有封面和歌词。
• 在线匹配：优先 QQ 音乐，失败时自动回退 iTunes；匹配到的封面和歌词直接写回音频文件标签，不需要电脑。
• 封面预览：右侧实时显示当前歌曲的专辑封面，没有封面时显示占位图。
• 歌词预览：按 L 打开内嵌歌词，F/X 逐行滚动，Z/C 翻页，ESC 或 L 返回。
• 匹配操作：Enter 匹配当前歌曲；A 匹配全部；Ctrl+A 全选后再按 Enter 一键匹配所有歌曲。
• 状态标识：COVER / LYRICS 两列圆点分别表示封面和歌词是否已有，绿点=有，白色空心=没有；当前歌曲行会放大显示并用青绿色边框标出。
• 主题切换：T 键切换浅色/青蓝深色主题，选择会自动记住。

使用说明：
• 需要联网访问匹配服务；首次匹配会在后台启动 Python 助手，任务结束后自动退出，不常驻后台。
• 已完整的歌曲会自动跳过，不会重复写入；修改标签前建议先备份音乐文件。
• 支持读取内嵌歌词（ID3 USLT / Vorbis LYRICS / MP4 ©lyr）并在设备上滚动预览。

注意事项：
• QQ 音乐接口为非官方接口，仅供个人使用；接口不可用时会自动回退 iTunes。
• 封面和歌词版权归原权利人所有，请仅用于个人合法拥有的音乐。

- Ping: per-reply latency, loss, min/avg/max/mdev and jitter
- Port scan: TCP port lists with open ports highlighted
- Traceroute: hop-by-hop path and latency, configurable max hops
- LAN scan: discover neighbours with IP/MAC/vendor and spot web admin pages
- DNS / ARP: A/AAAA and reverse lookups, IP to MAC with OUI vendor
- SSH / Telnet / Serial: interactive consoles on a shared 39x10 terminal
- Subnet calculator: separate IP and mask fields; network, wildcard,

- History and settings: save results, delete entries, language, theme,

- Wi-Fi: Enter connect the selected AP, C toggle channel chart, R rescan,

- History: Enter open a record, DEL delete, Esc returns to the list
- SSH form: Ctrl+S save bookmark, Ctrl+B load bookmark, Ctrl+K clear host keys
Network changes, Wi-Fi joins and hotspot switching ask for the device
password and run only on user action; the package installs no sudoers file
and no background service.

apps.summary: Pixel Aces is a software-rendered pixel-3D combat flight game
apps.description:
基于原作者@creativedash作品进行迁移开发，并针对CP0特性优化各项功能。(https://x.com/creativedash/status/2122000830895386680)
驾驶战机在程序化生成的岛屿、海洋与云层上空作战，支持俯视视角和尾随视角。按住 J 键使用机炮，将敌机保持在瞄准框内完成锁定，按 K 发射制导导弹。三名敌方王牌会巡航、转向攻击你、扫射并发射导弹；敌机逼近时威胁环会收缩。危急时刻按 R 键翻滚规避导弹：导弹擦身而过时时间会变慢，此时发射导弹可以打出三连反击。命中目标会迸出火花、冒出浓烟并伴随屏幕震动；被击落的敌机拖着火焰坠入海中。战机损毁时，你会乘坐弹射火箭升空：看着座舱盖炸开，在最后一刻脱离，然后登上前来接应的救援战机，全程配有无线电语音。内置扬声器可以播放合成的引擎、机炮和爆炸音效。仅键盘操作：方向键 或 Z/C/F/X 控制飞行，Enter 加速，J 机炮，K 导弹，R 翻滚，Tab 切换视角，Esc 退出。
Ported from the original work by @creativedash, all features optimized for CardputerZero (CP0).
(https://x.com/creativedash/status/2122000830895386680)
Fly a fighter over procedural islands, sea and clouds in top-down or chase view. Hold J for the cannon, hold an enemy in the sights to lock, K to loose a guided missile. Three enemy aces wander, turn on you, fire bursts and launch missiles of their own; the threat rings close as one comes in. Roll with R at the last moment to throw a missile off: time slows as it goes by, and a missile fired in that moment becomes a three-shot counter-attack.. Hits spark, smoke and shake the screen; shot-down foes fall burning into the sea. Lose your jet and you go out through the sky on the seat rocket: watch the canopy bloom, cut loose at the last moment and drop into the cockpit of the jet coming to pick you up, radio chatter and all. Synthesized engine, gun and explosion audio through the built-in speaker. Keyboard only: arrows or Z/C/F/X to fly, Enter boost, J gun, K missile, R roll, Tab view, Esc quit.

apps.description: LoRa Scanner shows and decodes what is on the air in the US 902-928 MHz band using the Cap LoRa-1262. Spectrum with max-hold and a waterfall show activity across the band. The Meshtastic Finder listens on each preset's default frequency and decodes the public default channel: text messages, node names, telemetry, positions and traceroutes (private channels stay encrypted). The LoRaWAN page hops the US915 channels of any sub-band (or the gateway downlink channels) and decodes frame headers: device address, network (The Things Network, Helium...), frame counter, port, and join requests with the device's EUI. Every packet is listed with full details and a hex dump, logged to ~/LoRaScan/packets.csv, and - with the Cap's GPS - plotted on a coverage map you can export as a Google Earth KML file. Open a pass to see its path on a sky chart, a countdown, rise/peak/set times with compass directions, and its live position while it is overhead. The Sky page shows every tracked satellite above the horizon right now.

Groups: space stations (ISS, Tiangong), the brightest satellites, amateur radio satellites and weather satellites. Orbit data comes from CelesTrak over Wi-Fi (cached, refreshed at most every 2 hours); the SGP4 orbit model is built in. Your location comes from the Cap LoRa-1262's GPS, or type it in; it is only stored on the device.

Keys: F / X move, Z / C change pages, Enter opens a pass, V shows naked-eye passes only, U updates orbit data, L types your location.

Network: interfaces, Wi-Fi signal and a live download/upload speed graph.
Power: 4-minute temperature history, battery time-left / time-to-full estimate, disk and uptime.
Level: a bubble level from the built-in motion sensor.
Sound: a live microphone loudness meter with one-key quiet calibration.

apps.title: Sparrow
apps.summary: An illuminated almanac of the real sky, your chart and your time.
apps.description:
Sparrow is a book of illuminated pages for the CardputerZero, drawn live as vector art in the manner of a medieval manuscript.

The pages:
- The Flight: a flight along the roads of a country where America and Britain meet, in the light of the hour (dawn, day, dusk, night).
- Moon & Stars: the real sky over your horizon, with the Moon in its true phase, 1,600 stars, the planets and the Sun.
- Zodiac Chart: the sky now as a Western chart, or as a Vedic one with your current periods.
- Date of Birth: enter it once in a candle-lit book; the pages below read it.
- Life Orrery: where you stand in a life of eighty years, by life, decade and year.
- Time Garden: the week as a morning glory, sown on Monday and in flower on Sunday.
- Biorhythm: your rhythms as an alchemist's stone and flask.
- Love: ten kinds of love as circles that draw your own mark.
- Polarity: Sun and Moon qualities in five pairs on an alchemist's balance.
- Tree of Life: an apple tree in the season of the date, the garden's life about it, and seven stations in glyph and verse.
- Triptych: past, present and future from your date of birth, in three panels of your numbers.
- I Ching: the day's figure from the Book of Changes, cast by the yarrow stalks from your date of birth.
- Seal of the Day: your number for the day as a sign to learn, a solid in its colour inside its halo.
- Tarot: the seventy-eight cards of the Waite-Smith deck, to turn through and to take apart.
- Pentagram Ritual: the Lesser Banishing Ritual of the Pentagram, to learn its words, to be guided through it as you turn with the device in your hand, and to recall.
- Resonance, Tuner and Vesica: what is vibrating around you, as a figure of sand, as a named tone, and as two waves that meet, from the microphone and the motion sensor.
- Body Chord, Attunement, Wild Pendulum and Stillness: biofeedback pages that find your breath, heartbeat and tremor, sound them as a chord, and lead the breath down with tones.

Navigation is the same everywhere, and it follows the signs printed on the keyboard: the arrow keys (Z, X, C and F, no FN needed) steer every page and OK acts, N opens the contents, H opens the help screen for the page in view, a page's own key opens it from anywhere, and DEL or ESC goes back. A steps the sound through silence, a quiet background score on the solfeggio tones and an offline narrator that reads the pages; S and D make it quieter and louder.

Sparrow opens with a hand. Choose five numbers, one on each fingertip, and they lock your profile: your date of birth and your choices are sealed in an encrypted file on the device and open only with those numbers. If you forget them there is no way back in, only a fresh start.

Everything is computed on the device. Sound from the microphone is analysed in memory and never stored. Sparrow needs no network and no account. Set your latitude and longitude in sparrow.conf for a true horizon.

Sparrow is an almanac and a biofeedback tool, not a medical device. It does not give medical advice, diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, or make health suggestions. For anything about your health, ask a qualified professional.

apps.summary: Local video with subtitles, audio tracks and handheld or HDMI playback
apps.description:
Play local videos on the CardputerZero's built-in display, or send the movie to a dedicated HDMI screen while keeping controls on the handheld.

Browse folders and mounted media without a full-card scan. Choose audio tracks and common text subtitles, including matching external SRT files. Subtitles start off. HDMI playback prefers TV audio and falls back to onboard sound when necessary.

Enter opens a file. Space pauses or resumes. Left/Right seek 10 seconds; Up/Down change volume. O selects the display, T opens audio/subtitle tracks, V selects audio output, M mutes, Esc returns to the browser, and Q exits to APPLaunch. W/A/S/D provide navigation fallbacks.

Version 0.1.7 adds one software-decoder retry per file load for a specific HDMI buffer-pool activation failure after hardware decoding. The retry preserves playback position, selected tracks and play/pause intent. Software decoding may be slower, and demanding files may need computer-side conversion.

Requires a CardputerZero running compatible Debian 13 ARM64 software with APPLaunch, GStreamer 1.26 and systemd 253 or newer. Dedicated HDMI playback temporarily releases the stock desktop and restores it on exit. The package installs a restricted nonroot console helper. Codec availability and smooth playback depend on the file. Streaming, playlists and saved playback positions are not included.

The screenshots are rendered UI previews. A tested 1920x816, 24 fps H.264/AAC source completed more than ten minutes of HDMI playback with captions, including recovery from one controlled startup allocation failure using software decoding. The tested TV output mode was 720p. Other file profiles can have different performance limits.

apps.summary: Net tools, WiFi audit, BLE sensors, tracker watch and a BLE sniffer in one app
apps.description:
Wireless Toolbox puts five wireless and network tools behind one menu on the CardputerZero.

• Net Tools — ping monitors, WiFi scan, LAN discovery (ARP + mDNS), port probe. Works out of the box.
• Home Sensors — read nearby BLE sensor beacons (temperature, humidity, door, motion) over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• Tracker Guard — spot unknown AirTag-style trackers that follow you, over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• WiFi Audit — scan 802.11, watch for deauth attacks and more. Needs a USB monitor-mode WiFi adapter; the built-in wlan0 stays your uplink.
• BLE Sniffer — capture Bluetooth LE packets to a Wireshark pcap. Needs an nRF Sniffer dongle.

The three built-in-radio tools run on any unit; the two that need extra hardware show a clear 'plug it in' screen when it isn't found. Key 4 (or Esc) backs out of any tool to the menu.

apps.description:
ZeroSub turns the CardputerZero and the M5Stack Cap CC1101 into a pocket radio and sensor tool.

Sub-GHz (CC1101): frequency analyzer, signal meter, Read and Read RAW captures on the 17 Flipper Zero default channels with AM270/AM650/FM238/FM476 presets, a saved-signal library, manual key entry, and Send limited to the EU licence-free bands.

Infrared: learn remotes, save them and send them again. Flipper zero compatible.

NFC (ST25R3916): read NFC-A, NFC-B, FeliCa and NFC-V (ISO 15693) tags and show the URL or text they hold; write saved NTAG and MIFARE Ultralight tags to blank ones and emulate them to a reader. NFC support is new and still being tested on hardware. Flipper zero compatible.

IMU: live motion readings from the BMI270 (acceleration, rotation, tilt, temperature), a compass with heading dial from the BMM150, and a bubble level.

Web Files: a small web file manager for your home folder, running while its page is open. Open the address shown on the device from a browser on the same network, log in with the PIN on screen, then browse, download, upload, rename and delete files, or install a .deb package.

Signals, remotes and tags are stored as Flipper Zero .sub, .ir and .nfc files, so they can be copied between ZeroSub and a Flipper in either direction. Requires the M5Stack Cap CC1101.
apps.depends: libc6, libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libpng16-16, libjpeg62-turbo, zlib1g, raspi-utils-core

apps.title: ZeroTracker
apps.summary: Pocket music tracker that reads and writes M8 songs and instruments
apps.description:
ZeroTracker is a music tracker for the CardputerZero, inspired by the M8 tracker and compatible with its song (.m8s) and instrument (.m8i) files.

- Eight tracks of songs, chains, phrases, instruments and tables.
- FM, WAV, MACRO (Braids models), HYPER and SAMPLER engines, with modulators, EQ and a sample editor that records from the microphone.
- Mixer with chorus, delay, reverb, master limiter and oscilloscopes.
- RENDER the song to WAV: the mix and a stem per track.
- LIBRARY: download packs of songs, instruments and samples on the device.
- Seven languages, themes, and a tooltip for every key (SYM + 4..8).

At the first start it creates ~/ZeroTracker with a demo song, instruments and a CC0 sample kit. APP > MANUAL shows a QR code to the getting-started guide. Not affiliated with Dirtywave.

apps.title: ZeroTVBGone
apps.summary: Turn off almost any TV: sends every known power-off code over IR
apps.description: A port of TV-B-Gone, by Mitch Altman and Limor Fried, to the CardputerZero. Pick Europe or Americas / Asia, point at the TV and press ENTER: it sends about 140 power-off codes in under a minute, most popular brands first, through the built-in infrared LED. ENTER or ESC stops, hold ESC to exit.

apps.title: ZSynth
apps.summary: Pocket groovebox: synths, mic sampler, drums, patterns and songs
apps.description:
ZSynth turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket groovebox.

Four tracks: a lead synth, a bass synth, a mic sampler and a drum kit. Each song has eight patterns, from 1 to 32 steps in any time signature (4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 6/8...), and a chain that plays them in order.

- Play live: arm recording and play along while the loop runs, with a metronome.
- Step editing: a drum-machine grid with accents, and a piano roll for writing notes and chords step by step.
- Sound design: shape each track on the Sound screen (wave, filter, envelope, detune), and hear changes as you play.
- Instrument library: 23 starter instruments. Browse them while your loop plays to hear each one in context, and save your own.
- Sampler: record up to 5 seconds from the built-in mic, or use the 18 starter samples (FM piano, harpsichord, marimba, kalimba, tenor sax, harmonica, gong and more) from the CC0 Versilian Community Sample Library, tuned to play across the keyboard.
- Comes with a demo song, night-shift: 87 seconds of dance-punk at 118 BPM.

Everything is saved as you go. Press Fn+H in the app for the key guide.
